allowed_pause_reasons: scope-changing missing fact or irreversible high-cost decision
official rule, fidelity asset, rights, or license hard-stop

forward_walkthroughs.case: the user asks to fix one named workflow finding
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the assistant edits, validates, installs when authorized by the request, runs required regression, and reports completion without pausing after each internal stage

forward_walkthroughs.case: the user says 推进下一步 after a valid stage receipt
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the assistant completes that receipt's single next action and its required validation without expanding to all downstream scopes

forward_walkthroughs.case: the user says complete all P2 work and report only after completion
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the assistant continues across dependency-satisfied P2 stages and pauses only for a legitimate contract reason

forward_walkthroughs.case: a normal stage receipt is emitted while more authorized work remains
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the receipt informs progress and execution continues without waiting for an acknowledgement

forward_walkthroughs.case: one missing asset blocks production but research and concept documentation remain independent
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the assistant completes the independent work before asking one minimal question or naming one unblock action

forward_walkthroughs.case: an observed quality failure can be repaired without changing the selected direction
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the assistant returns to the responsible stage, preserves the failed version, repairs, retests, and continues

forward_walkthroughs.case: the requested concept-only scope is fully verified
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the assistant reports exact completion and stops without entering production-candidate scope

forward_walkthroughs.case: final files are ready but actual submission was not explicitly authorized
forward_walkthroughs.expected: the assistant completes every preparatory step and pauses before the external upload or submission action
